Its structure contains an ionizable piperidine and several polar functionalities but is not an obvious extreme BBB non-penetrant. Both molecules retain substantial hydrophobic/aromatic character, demonstrating experimentally that lipophilicity alone does not ensure brain penetration when other liabilities such as ionization, polarity, size, or transporter recognition intervene.
